cases.name: The preview starts covered in the separate basic outfit
All 25 body and garment parts use the shared native skeleton
Bare hands and feet are body parts, separate from sleeves and boots
Visible body and garment skins produce actual deformed vertices
Every preview button survived scene serialization
The underlying leg mesh changes during running
Basic shorts deform with the running leg, without repainting the body
Hair and coat buttons replace their separate artwork
Changing clothes preserves the head and running pose
New sleeve variants still deform on the same arm bones
Removing the outer outfit shows all basic clothes over the intact body
Putting garments on does not reset the animated body mesh
The outer outfit replaces all basic layers, without baking clothes onto skin
Jade and crimson outfits swap coat and sleeve sprites while deforming on arm bones
Azure greatsword button swaps weapon sprite and shadow
Crimson flame sword button selects weapon style 2
All five 2D weapon buttons cycle cleanly and restore the short sword
Strike swings the sword through a different impact pose
Animation never changes the actor foot position
Appearance is independent per actor and leaves shared sources unchanged
Real held keyboard input moves and selects running
Moving left and right flips FacingSign and horizontal scale
Releasing movement returns to idle
Meadow arena loads obstacles and blocks movement into rock center (-7.8, -0.7)
Real J input starts a finite strike and updates its label
The strike ends and returns to idle
Eye controls act independently of clothing
The running preview button uses the same body animation
Normal zoom keeps the entire view inside the meadow
